claim.claim-text: 1. A system for determining a predicted state of a parked vehicle in an environment of a host vehicle, the system comprising: at least one processing unit (110) programmed to:
2. The system of claim 1, wherein

the change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle includes a change from a non-illuminated state to an illuminated state; or wherein the change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle includes a change from an illuminated state to a non-illuminated state.

3. The system of any of claims 1-2, wherein the change in the illumination state corresponds to illumination of parking lights of the parked vehicle to illumination of brake lights of the parked vehicle.
4. The system of any of claims 1-2, wherein the at least one light corresponds to at least one of a taillight and a headlight of the parked vehicle.
5. The system of claim 4, wherein the analyzing at least two of the plurality of images comprises monitoring the identified taillight and/or headlight of the parked vehicle.

6. The system of claim 2, wherein the processing unit (110) is configured to, based on a change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle from a non-illuminated state to an illuminated state, determine that the predicted state of the parked vehicle includes an indication that the parked vehicle has been started.

7. The system of any of claims 1-6, wherein the processing unit (110) is configured to monitor one or more portions of plurality of images to determine a change in an image characteristic of a door of the parked vehicle to determine that the predicted state includes an indication that the door of the parked vehicle is expected to open within a predetermined time period.
8. The system of any of claims 1-7, wherein the processing unit (110) is configured to:

10. The method of claim 9, wherein

the change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle includes a change from a non-illuminated state to an illuminated state; or wherein the change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle includes a change from an illuminated state to a non-illuminated state.

11. The method of any of claims 9-10, wherein the change in the illumination state corresponds to illumination of parking lights of the parked vehicle to illumination of brake lights of the parked vehicle.

12. The method of any of claims 9-11, wherein the at least one light corresponds to at least one of a taillight and a headlight of the parked vehicle, and wherein the analyzing at least two of the plurality of images comprises monitoring the identified taillight and/or headlight of the parked vehicle.

13. The method of claim 10, further comprising, based on a change in the illumination state of the at least one light associated with the parked vehicle from a non-illuminated state to an illuminated state, determining that the predicted state of the parked vehicle includes an indication that the parked vehicle has been started.

14. The method of any of claims 9-13, further comprising monitoring one or more portions of plurality of images to determine a change in an image characteristic of a door of the parked vehicle to determine that the predicted state includes an indication that the door of the parked vehicle is expected to open within a predetermined time period.
15. The method of any of claims 9-14, further comprising:
16. A computer-readable medium comprising instructions that when executed by a processing unit (110), cause the processing unit (110) to carry out the method according to any of claims 9-15.
